==Example Question==
What is the answer to this question?

What '''I if''' told you there is a mistake in this sentence? What would you say the mistake is?

==90%==
Logically, which of these children’s characters could be included in this sequence?
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="2" |Humpty Dumpty   Tinky Winky   Andy Pandy
|-
|'''Incy Wincy'''
|Postman Pat
|}
The sequence is made up of characters whose names rhyme, so Incy Wincy is the only correct option.

== 80% ==
Which photo of these famous landmarks cannot be real?

[[File:Landmark.png|frameless]]

'''A''': The Statue of Liberty has the London skyline behind it.

==70%==
Which shape comes next?

[[File:Shape sequence.png|frameless]]

'''A''': They are just numbers placed next to their mirror image. The next number in the sequence is 4.

==45%==
In this puzzle, which animal is the heaviest?

[[File:Scales.png|frameless]]

'''B''': If the elephant and mouse weigh the same, and the mouse is heaver than the bear, and the rabbit is heavier than the elephant, then the rabbit must be the heaviest.

==40%==

[[File:Candle.png|frameless]]

'''B''': It is the only candle that is alight.

==35%==
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="4" |Which of these does not mean “backwards not forwards” in a foreign language?
|-
|Inapoi nu înainte
| Geriye, ileriye doğru değil
|'''Esrever ni hsilgne tsuj si siht'''

You didn’t need to know any foreign languages but you did need to spot that option C when read backwards says “This is just English in reverse”

==30%==
If your newspaper has 20 pages – with the front cover as page 1 and the back cover as page 20 – and you read every page, how many times do you have to turn the page?

'''10''': Many people think the answer is 9 because they forget to turn the back page

==25%==
What number between 1 and 100 has the most syllables when said out loud?

Seven is the only number between one and ten that has two syllables – the rest have only one. So, the number with the most syllables has to be '''77'''.

==20%==
What well-known three-word expression is written in code below?

THO'''DEEP'''UGHT

'''Deep in thought'''

==15%==
Which animal is half go'''at''' and one third '''c'''ow?

If you take the ‘c’ from cow, which is one third of its letters, and place it next to the ‘at’ from goat, which is half its letters, you get ‘'''cat'''’.

==10%==
Which is the odd one out?

'''Coffee'''<br>Dresser<br>Grammar<br>Potato<br>Revive<br>Uneven

If you take the first letter of every word and put it at the end it would spell the same word backwards – apart from coffee

==5%==
What can be placed between 3 and 7 to produce a number that is bigger than 3 and smaller than 7?

If you put a '''decimal point''' between 3 and 7 it becomes 3.7

== 1%==
On a digital 24-hour clock that displays hours, minutes and seconds, how many times in each 24-hour period do all six digits change simultaneously?

09:59:59 becomes 10:00:00<br>19:59:59 becomes 20:00:00<br>23:59:59 becomes 00:00:00
